title: Future recording and how he sees himself
summary: He hopes new albums bring money and calls himself a good entertainer with fair showmanship.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Looking back: no regrets, what it all meant

blocks.x: So are there any plans for you to record again? I know you did a thing for Barclay.

Really I'm just hoping that these albums really suit my mind well if they do it. I mean maybe I can surprise a lot of people that things have been hung in me so long that they haven't come out. All I want to do is see some money and maybe I can get some pleasure out of myself.
What do you think yourself of as a musician? Do you think you call yourself a blues musician or a jazz musician? Do you put a name on yourself?

Well I'll just put it this way. I consider being a good entertainer with fair showmanship. In the job I'm proud to be of some service to the public or then others just for myself alone because I really enjoy my work, you know. Yeah, that's a good way to be. Especially I could enjoy it better if we could keep groups together. I mean it's too hard to keep assuring different people the same thing over and over and over, and each one of them is going to have a different opinion or accent about it, you know. Right.
